name: Rugone Rugone Xever 7 Pro
pros: Wi-Fi support (Wi-Fi 802.11 b/g/n, hotspot) for data-free browsing and connectivity
8 MP, AF camera capable of capturing good photos for its release era
Standard multi-core processor chipset provides balanced everyday performance
Li-Ion 3000 mAh battery offers solid operating endurance for daily use
cons: No official IP rating for dust or water resistance
Standard charging speeds without ultra-fast charging support

reviews.title: Solid performance for its 2015 launch era
reviews.body: Picking this up around its release period, the Android experience felt snappy and responsive for the price tier. The 8 MP, AF camera delivered reliable shots in outdoor lighting.

reviews.title: Reliable battery and daily usability
reviews.body: The Li-Ion 3000 mAh power cell paired with Rugone's software tuning easily lasted through a full work day with mixed web browsing, calls, and media playback.

reviews.title: Refined hardware styling and build
reviews.body: The physical chassis of the Rugone Rugone Xever 7 Pro feels well-balanced in hand. Its Standard compact design make it easy to hold during long daily sessions.

reviews.title: Great value for the hardware specifications
reviews.body: For the price point, getting Standard multi-core processor performance alongside 16GB / 32GB storage, microSD slot made the Rugone Rugone Xever 7 Pro an easy recommendation among rivals in 2015.

reviews.title: Smooth day-to-day software responsiveness
reviews.body: Operating on Android, the user interface is intuitive with smooth system transitions. Core apps and browsing run without noticeable stutter.

reviews.title: Dependable display and audio clarity
reviews.body: The screen (IPS LCD capacitive touchscreen) produces vibrant colors for video streaming, and call clarity through the earpiece is crystal clear.

reviews.title: A well-rounded package from Rugone
reviews.body: Overall, the Rugone Rugone Xever 7 Pro proved to be a durable and well-engineered mobile device representing Rugone's design philosophy nicely.
